reasoning: Rebuilt after the Nov 19 Q4 FY26 print on the approved quarterly driver set. Facts: Q4 revenue 1,994 (guide 1,930-1,950), orders 2,339 (1.17x), non-GAAP op margin 35.8%, FY26 7,157 / 32.7%; FY27 base case +20% (CEO and CFO), Q1 guide 2,040-2,060 / $3.63-3.69, capex ~275, tax 14%; CFO expects mid-to-upper-40% operating leverage and says supply in 12-24 AI SKUs extended backlog by $200-300M. Alternative-lane evidence: Neo Reports (Nov 22) shows the AI tape breaking (SOX -17% week, VIX 36, a BofA survey with 52% expecting a hyperscaler capex cut, Morgan Stanley's +7% 2028 cloud capex), Navellier's Substack gives the order mix (CSG +75%, EISG +25%, APAC +45%; its 'backlog $8.13B' is FY orders, an error), Earnings Whispers shows sentiment falling to 28% before the print, Advantest's and Anritsu's raised forecasts (Oct 29) confirm AI test demand, Polymarket prices a 9% Taiwan-invasion risk by end-2027, and LightCounting (Oct 8) gives the market path plus an explicit correction warning. Build: wireline +40% (below the market's +76% and the orders-led case, above the Bumpy Ride case), wireless +10%, ADG +8%, EI +12% -> FY27 8,475 (+18.4%, below the guide by 1.3%), FY28 +11.6%, FY29 +8.4%; segment margins 36.5%/31.5% then 35.5%/31.0%. Value: P/E 18.85x ex-SBC (k = 0.8 shrink to a 22.4x costed peer median, -0.5 turn post-horizon risk), FCF yield 3.39% (tech-name leg), mid-cycle 29% leg. Downside (P10) moves every driver as an inventory-correction year with -5 turns; upside (P90) converts the backlog with +4 turns. Research limits: no dated post-print consensus page was reachable, so the 2026-11-19/20 pre-revision consensus is used and flagged; Benzinga, chartmill and quantisnow refused fetches; Stocktwits pages found were from 2024 and were dropped. The mid-cycle custom leg is not driver-linked.
